lines.speaker: Your boss
lines.text: The Chief Executive's back from that retreat, the one with the goats, and apparently we're not behind any more, we're exercising strategic patience.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Is that different from being behind?

lines.speaker: Your boss
lines.text: It's more expensive, so don't go spreading it about, because nobody on our floor's heard it yet. Same again?
Your boss buys a round and claims it as stakeholder engagement, with you as the stakeholder.
You get to the front early, where the only other person is from Facilities, testing the chairs.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: Nobody's early, but mind that one, because it's been reported.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: There's a new north star, they tell me, and I've been asked to keep the fire exit clear of it.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: As I understand it, you don't get there, you just face it.

title: A demonstration, in the fourth-floor corridor

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: I love the lanyard. So right now finance has its numbers and you have yours, and it all ends in a meeting. Am I close?

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: With us, that's gone, and you have a single source of truth.

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: It's yours, while I'm talking to you.
